{warning}'''Support for Flash has ended starting with Firefox for Android version 56.''' Like other popular browsers, Firefox no longer supports Flash content on mobile websites and [http://blogs.adobe.com/flashplayer/2012/06/flash-player-and-android-update.html#sthash.X0uGKiDQ.dpbs Adobe has removed Flash for Android in 2012]. For websites you rely on that still use Flash, please contact the website owner directly and ask them to update to open standards.{/warning}
